# Key Findings (auto-generated)

Factual rollup of the current feature dataset. Interpretation lives in the final report.

## Overview
- Posts: 78,309 across 2 platforms (youtube: 67,374, instagram: 10,935).
- Content date range: 2016-04-20 to 2026-11-22.

## Sentiment by platform (English)
- instagram: positive 84.5%, neutral 7.7%, negative 7.8%.
- youtube: positive 60.4%, neutral 22.4%, negative 17.2%.

## Engagement vs sentiment
- Avg engagement percentile by sentiment: negative 0.489, neutral 0.496, positive 0.505 (spread 0.016).
- Relationship is essentially flat (sentiment does not predict engagement).

## Dominant topics (by volume)
- T0: time, agent, new, think - 48,036 posts.
- T5: business, help, right, build - 10,727 posts.
- T2: course, engineer, hi, youtube - 2,055 posts.
- T3: free, free praise, praise, paid - 1,831 posts.
- T4: chat, gpt, chat gpt, claude - 1,586 posts.

## Emerging vs declining topics (recent vs earlier in window)
- Rising: T5: business, help, right, build (+3.35 pts).
- Rising: T2: course, engineer, hi, youtube (+0.18 pts).
- Rising: T3: free, free praise, praise, paid (-0.01 pts).
- Declining: T4: chat, gpt, chat gpt, claude (-1.05 pts).
- Declining: T0: time, agent, new, think (-2.08 pts).

## Top keywords (by volume)
- ChatGPT - 15,823 posts.
- AI Agents - 13,683 posts.
- Automation - 7,850 posts.
- Startup - 6,915 posts.
- SEO - 5,958 posts.

## Models
- Production sentiment model: vader (deploy-domain macro-F1 0.6493).
- Topic model: NMF, k=7, UMass coherence -0.9975 (more coherent than LDA).
